description: Phase-33 RESEARCH-ONLY autonomous mechanism enumeration knobs. Read ONLY by scripts/mechanism_enumerator.py (un-wired). Given a located source bundle (target function body + sibling/callee bodies), the enumerator GENERATES candidate mechanisms from source-observable shapes crossed with a GENERIC suspicion catalog. It reads the generic DeFi vocab BY REFERENCE from config/root_cause_mechanisms.json (it does NOT copy or modify that file). The enumerator never sees award labels, issue IDs, contest text, or expected_mechanism.json. No subject-specific (e.g. dittoeth) identifiers appear here. Candidate mechanism TYPES are restricted to the 7 the P32 discriminator can score; the 10-class taxonomy below is a DESCRIPTIVE tag only. is_gate:false research_only:true routes_in_production:false routed_manifest_ids:[].
